scope: Independent pre-call metadata-only review of amendment 006. No intervention answers, verification flags, recovery rates, arm differences, or response caches were opened.

scientific_plan.primary_rule: Positive repair-minus-fresh difference and exact two-sided McNemar p<0.05 in every one of 512 binary completions; otherwise inconclusive.

findings: The byte-only post-loss inventory contains exactly 2,268 request keys. Every current main-cache file matched its inventory hash in the independent check: no missing, extra, or changed cache bytes; all 2,124 previously protected prefix hashes match.

The nine unavailable request identities are the preserved eight unknown cells from four whole pairs plus one new feedback_repair cell. The same source has a terminal fresh_retry partner, and its cache SHA-256 matches the bound analysis plan. No response contents were opened.

The new plan keeps the fixed 600-source cohort, separates 595 fully observed pairs for conditional inference, retains the known partial-pair partner in each of 512 all-cohort completions, and preserves the all-completions McNemar rule. Hashes of the helper, synthetic tests, frozen 003 calculator, and 003 plan match the declared values.

The 006 runtime is one-shot and permits only the exact 52 unsent dispatch suffix. It byte-binds all prior caches and terminal errors, preserves pending artifacts, uses four-request waves, drains a wave and stops on a new infrastructure failure, and does not automatically restart.

The monitor binds the exact 006 script, amendment hash, startup nonce, worker/collector identities and 2,268-cache prefix. Its completion condition requires all 1,200 slots processed, 1,191 terminal records, the exact nine pending keys, 52 new terminal requests, two retained service failures, zero new transport failures and an intact prefix.

The 30 runtime and worker mock tests pass. The separate five-test missing-outcome/reporting suite passes, and the ten-test metadata delivery/replay suite passes, including a 1,200-slot zero-call offline receipt and rejection of a 1,199-slot receipt. Three harmless worker probes report zero model calls and no automatic restart.
